breathless.tooltip.insert_hint: Click a filter onto the mask to insert it
breathless.tooltip.remove_hint: Right-click the mask to take a filter out
breathless.tooltip.filter_reinforced: Reinforced: wears out half as fast
breathless.tooltip.tonic: Wear a gas mask when you drink it
death.attack.breathless_sear: %1$s crashed due to an unexpected issue.
advancements.breathless.root.title: IFAAR: Breathless
advancements.breathless.mt_ebott.title: Mt. Ebott
advancements.breathless.mt_ebott.descrip: Go below Y=0. Legend says those who go down do not come back.
advancements.breathless.the_mask.title: The Mask
advancements.breathless.the_mask.descrip: Craft a gas mask. Something to breathe through.
advancements.breathless.spotless_mind.de: Slot a filter into a mask. Clean air, for now.
advancements.breathless.yeah_mr_white.de: Wear a mask holding two filters. One for each lung.
advancements.breathless.purple_rain.desc: Craft a reinforced filter. Built to outlast you.
advancements.breathless.nightcrawler.des: Wear the night-vision mask below Y=0. You see well in the dark. Something sees you better.
advancements.breathless.the_breaking_poi: Let the visor crack a second time. Glass was never meant to hold.
advancements.breathless.unwelcome_guests: Have a filter run out below Y=0. It lets itself in.
advancements.breathless.ya_like_jazz.des: Drink a tonic. Something to take the edge off.
advancements.breathless.annihilation.des: Get the Stagnation effect. Something has taken root in you.
advancements.breathless.lose_yourself.de: Become Moribund. There is less of you than before.
advancements.breathless.the_thing_that_h: Reach 100% exposure. The air no longer lets you leave.
advancements.breathless.a_quiet_place.de: Spend 5 minutes below Y=0 without sprinting. Do not run. It hears running.
advancements.breathless.i_am_no_evil.des: Put on a mask while already exposed. Too late to be clean, but you tried.
advancements.breathless.iyearnforabody.d: Survive the F13ND purge. It left. You still remember it was there.
advancements.breathless.theweaknessoffle: Survive the purge with 1 heart or less. One heart, still yours.
advancements.breathless.the_silence.desc: Die to spores. Your body split open from the inside. Nothing was left to say.
advancements.breathless.error_log.title: error_log.txt
advancements.breathless.error_log.descri: Die to the sear. Unexpected issue. Details were not saved.
advancements.breathless.breathless.title: Breathless
advancements.breathless.breathless.descr: Spend 10 minutes below Y=0 without any exposure. You were never here.
advancements.breathless.not_alone.title: Not Alone
advancements.breathless.not_alone.descri: Get spotted by a Stagnated. Something is looking back.
advancements.breathless.at_peace_at_last: Kill a Stagnated. Its soul can now be free.
advancements.breathless.run_rabbit.title: Run Rabbit, Run Rabbit
advancements.breathless.run_rabbit.descr: Outrun a chasing Stagnated until it loses you. It forgot what it was chasing.
advancements.breathless.bravery.title: Bravery
advancements.breathless.bravery.descript: Kill a Stagnated in iron armor. Hands shaking, yet raised. I am not afraid.
advancements.breathless.determination.de: Get dug out to by a Stagnated miner. My hands may grow weak, but never my resolve.
advancements.breathless.perseverance.des: Get a Stagnated builder to tower up to you. No matter what may come, I will keep pushing.
advancements.breathless.my_mind_of_many_: Lure a Stagnated with a sculk sensor. It heard something. It always hears something.
advancements.breathless.hate_filled_amal: See a Warden kill a Stagnated. It can no longer tell friend from foe due to its rage.
Watch a Stagnated kill a zombie or skeleton. Not its own.
advancements.breathless.finally_still.de: Kill 10 Stagnated. Ten who can rest now.
